basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: PGT (Mathematics): Post Graduation Degree with 50% in the concerned subject with B.Ed. TGT (English): Bachelor Degree with at least 50% in aggregate in the concerned subject with B.Ed. and CTET pass (Class VI to VIII). Nursery Teacher for Balvatika-3: Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Nursery Teacher Education / Pre-School Education / D.E.C.Ed. or B.Ed. (Nursery).

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated monthly pay: PGT Rs. 27,500; TGT Rs. 26,250; Balwatika Nursery Teacher Rs. 21,250

how_to_apply: Register on the Samvida Sathi portal (https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/register); it is mandatory.
Download the application form from the school website https://gangrani.kvs.ac.in/.
Fill the form completely in capital letters; use one form for one post.
Report at the school premises on 19.11.2026 at 9:00 AM with the form, 01 latest passport size photograph, all original certificates and self-attested photocopies.
Registration is from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM; no candidate will be allowed after 10 AM.
important_instructions: Apply separately for more than one post Candidates must appear in person and bring original documents

rows.qualification: Post Graduation Degree with 50% in the concerned subject from recognized University with B.Ed. Experience preferable.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary, part-time and contractual for the 2026-27 session only Services automatically terminated on the last working day of the session, when a regular employee joins, or if not found satisfactory Appearance on the selection panel is not a basis for appointment Pro-rata pay for part of a month; no payment for vacation and breaks

content_sections.heading: How Will KV Gangrani Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of application forms for eligibility Interview Panel based on interview and merit The panel will be formed based on the interview and merit If interview marks are equal, preference to the candidate with the higher percentage in the minimum qualification Selected candidates will be called on a contract basis in seniority order as per vacancy

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for KV Gangrani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 19 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for KV Gangrani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 19 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for KV Gangrani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 27,500 for PGT (Mathematics), Rs. 26,250 for TGT (English), Rs. 21,250 for Nursery Teacher for Balvatika-3.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PGT (Mathematics): Post Graduation Degree with 50% in the concerned subject with B.Ed. TGT (English): Bachelor Degree with at least 50% in aggregate in the concerned subject with B.Ed. and CTET pass (Class VI to VIII). Nursery Teacher for Balvatika-3: Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Nursery Teacher Education / Pre-School Education / D.E.C.Ed. or B.Ed. (Nursery). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration on the Samvida Sathi portal is mandatory. Children or family members of a KVS employee must submit written information with the application form.

faq.question: Q6. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates arriving after 10:00 AM will not be allowed. Candidates not found eligible on the basis of application forms will not be interviewed.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of application forms for eligibility. Interview. Panel based on interview and merit. The panel will be formed based on the interview and merit.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary, part-time and contractual for the 2026-27 session only. Services automatically terminated on the last working day of the session, when a regular employee joins, or if not found satisfactory. Appearance on the selection panel is not a basis for appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kendriya Vidyalaya Gangrani, Kushinagar.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Completely filled application form downloaded from the school website; 01 latest passport size photograph; All original certificates; One self-attested photocopy of each certificate and mark sheet; Experience certificates if experience is in CBSE recognized schools; Written information if a child or family member of a KVS employee.
